# CANDIDATE: test_stub_dependencies

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We want to ensure that every stub file in `backtest/tools/` that marks a pipeline step (via its docstring) actually points to an existing file. This prevents referencing non-existent steps in the pipeline and maintains integrity of the stub-based workflow.

## Mechanism

The test will:
1. Use `grep -l "STATUS: STUB" backtest/tools/*.py` to find all stub-marked files.
2. For each file, extract the top-level docstring (first triple-quoted string).
3. Treat the docstring as a file path relative to the repository root.
4. Assert that the file at that path exists on disk.
5. Fail the test if any stub's docstring does not resolve to an existing file.

3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS -- this test produces no P&L time series; the concept of OOS does not apply. We have verified the test passes on the current codebase (in-sample) and have not conducted an out-of-sample evaluation because it is a deterministic file-existence check.
